liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Crosstown Traffic** (2 reviews): Described as frantic yet tight, leaving the listener wanting more; The organ overshadows the guitar especially on this song [8][11]

## The recordings

- **soulive2005-07-19.flacf** (recommended): FM broadcast; 6 songs; 53 min; rated 5/5 by 18 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates the recording's quality among the best they have heard; Reviewer says this is the best-sounding Soulive show on the site; Reviewer calls it the best sound yet from the band, with superb recording quality [3][4][6][7][8][10][11]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Radio DJ's [1]
- Some audience members clap in time during the solos, which the reviewer finds a downside [7]
- Listed as the 19 July 2005 Stockholm Jazz Festival recording [15]
- Reviewer considers it a must-have for Soulive fans, unlike many shows on the site they find overrated [6]
- Reviewer, who has heard many Soulive shows online, calls this the best one [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **soulive2005-07-19.flacf**: taped by unknown; transferred by unknown; source: Swedish Radio (FM) [1]
